title: Character inspector equipment slot selector - same white bg as bug 2

sections.what: Same as bug 2 but in the character inspector (world items), not the library. The equipment slot multi-select in the item inspector (node-equip-slots-*) has a white background with unreadable light gray text.
files: _Audited 2026-08-03 - duplicate file consolidated into this record._

custom.root_cause: Same as bug 2 - Choices.js default light theme with no dark-mode CSS overrides. The fix in bug 2 may already cover this if the CSS overrides apply globally to all `.choices__*` elements, but needs verification.

extra.status_note: Fixed (same global Choices.js CSS overrides as bug 2)
